title: Triage module
story: Severity, fraud and subrogation triage (REQ-07, REQ-08, REQ-09)
acceptance: service(ctx) exports runTriage, getLatestTriage, listTriage; result validates against TriageResult.schema.json with severity score 0-100 and band, complexity, fraudIndicators [{code,weight,reason}], subrogation {flag,reasons,confidence}, plain-language explanation, inputsHash
runTriage skips when inputsHash unchanged unless force, increments attempt, publishes claim.triaged (no PII)

deterministic fraud indicators tested individually in tests/unit/triage/fraud.test.mjs: LOSS_NEAR_INCEPTION (<=30 days), LATE_REPORT, NO_POLICE_REPORT_THEFT, PRIOR_CLAIMS, NARRATIVE_EVIDENCE_MISMATCH, ROUND_NUMBER_ESTIMATE
subscribes to claim.coverage.verified and claim.evidence.extracted; rerun only if inputsHash changed and claim not in_review; test in tests/unit/triage/events.test.mjs
GET/POST /claims/{claimId}/triage routes match openapi x-roles; node --test tests/unit/triage/*.test.mjs passes with fake claims, evidence, coverage, rules, ai
brief:
Implement per modules.md#triage and TriageResult schema. Inputs: claims.getClaimBundle(claimId), evidence.getAcceptedFacts, coverage.getLatestVerification, rules.evaluate({stage:'triage',facts}) (actions add_severity and set_complexity); all via ctx.modules, each wrapped so absence/failure degrades gracefully (tests inject fakes). Build a normalized facts object (no raw PII in logs), compute inputsHash=sha256 of canonical JSON. Call ctx.ai.run for severity, fraud_signals and subrogation passing {facts}; merge with deterministic logic in separate files (severity.mjs, fraud.mjs, subrogation.mjs, complexity.mjs, explain.mjs, service.mjs, routes.mjs, index.mjs). Severity: AI score plus rule add_severity deltas, clamp 0-100, band from thresholds (low<25, medium<50, high<75, severe). Complexity from parties, injuries, coverage issues, rules set_complexity. Fraud: always compute the deterministic indicators listed, union with AI indicators by code (max weight), score = capped sum scaled 0-100. Subrogation: flag if other party at fault cues, citation of other driver in accepted facts (citedParty), or rear-end where insured is struck; reasons list and confidence. Explanation is plain language sentences built from drivers; record provider/model/confidence from the severity ai result. Table triage_results as listed; attempt increments per claim. Pitfalls: event payload ids/codes/scores only; idempotent on evt.id; avoid retriggering loops (claim.triaged must not trigger triage); read core-runtime-api.md for store/bus.
SHARED AI TASK I/O SHAPES (all teams code against these; local provider must emit them exactly): ai.run returns {output,provider,model,confidence,explanation,usage,unconfirmed?}. Provider interface (src/ai/providers/<name>.mjs default export factory (ctx,opts)=>{name, available():Promise<boolean>, run(task,input,{tier,schema}):Promise<{output,confidence,explanation,usage,model}|{refusal:true}>}). Outputs: extract_narrative in {text} out {lossType,lossDate,location,injuries:boolean,injuryCues[],atFault:'insured'|'other'|'unknown',cues[]}; extract_document in {kind?,text,filename} out {kind,fields:[{name,value,confidence,provenance:{snippet}}],needsReview}; classify_photo in {filename,metadata?} out {kind:'photo',damageAreas[],vehicle:{make,model,color},fields:[same as above],needsReview}; severity in {facts} out {score 0-100,band,drivers[]}; fraud_signals in {facts} out {score,indicators:[{code,weight,reason}]}; subrogation in {facts} out {flag,reasons[],confidence}; summarize in {facts} out {summary,bullets[]}; next_best_actions in {facts} out {actions:[{code,label,reason,priority}]}. Field names for extracted document facts: policeReportNumber, citedParty, atFaultParty, estimateTotal, repairShop, lossDate, vin, damageAreas.

verdicts.reason: All criteria met; 27/27 triage tests pass; routes/roles match openapi; events PII-free; only additive subrogation.confidence (contract-change posted)

escapedDefects.summary: Triage double-counted injury (AI score + tenant add_severity) and ignored drivability/habitability: severity off by one band
